title: How to Read This Big Five Report
body: This report uses the five broad Big Five dimensions, their facets, relative reference positions, cross-trait patterns, and context-specific suggestions to help you interpret your current response pattern. Use it for self-observation, communication, and next-step planning—not for diagnosis, hiring decisions, proof of ability, or predictions about life outcomes.
access_note: Results are affected by response status, sample reference, and current life stage. Think of percentiles and dimension descriptions as interpretive clues rather than fixed identity labels.
